fields.description: TAP Language this Vocallabs agent serves. Each parent VoiceAgentSettings row must have at most ONE enabled mapping per language (enforced in the controller's validate hook).
fields.label: Language

fields.description: Vocallabs agent UUID delivered to the initiateVocallabsCall mutation when a student speaks this language. Required when the row is enabled.
fields.label: Agent ID

fields.description: Toggle this off to take a single language out of rotation without removing the row. When disabled, the resolver skips this mapping and falls back to VoiceAgentSettings.agent_id (the parent's default).
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Operator notes (e.g., 'Hindi persona v3, deployed 2026-05-28' or 'Tamil female voice, test pending'). Not read by code.
fields.label: Description
